Lanolin Farm—About Us

Lanolin Farm is home to two different breeds of sheep, each known for its unique characteristics. The first breed grows short, white wool that feels very soft. The other breed grows gray wool that is long and coarse. We shear the sheep twice a year to collect the wool.

Wool can be purchased from our farm store either as raw material or as yarn that we process on-site. The yarn can be used to make sweaters, hats, or blankets. We offer several colors of dyed wool as well as undyed wool that retains its natural color.

Eurotrade Textile Magazine

AMSTERDAM (5 May)—Yesterday, the nonprofit organization Sustainable Textile Partnership, based in the Netherlands, released a report concerning the Turkish garment trade. It concludes that the Turkish garment industry could cut its annual spending by 18 percent by recycling cotton waste from its factories and fabric mills. The report was partially funded by the government of Turkey.

The Turkish garment industry imports thousands of metric tonnes of cotton a year. But it also throws away a mountain of cotton waste left over from sewn items. At present, some of this waste, including discarded fibres and leftover yarn, is used as filling for mattresses, but most of it is burned as rubbish. Recycling more of the scraps could reduce cotton imports and save substantial amounts of money, according to the partnership's report.

Onur Arslan, president of the Garment Manufacturers Association of Turkey, said, “Industry leaders are keenly interested in understanding the impacts of recycling.”

items.question_translation: 根据文章，土耳其会如何处理一部分棉花废料？

questions.content_translation:
《Eurotrade 纺织杂志》

阿姆斯特丹（5月5日）——昨天，总部位于荷兰的非营利组织 Sustainable Textile Partnership 发布了一份有关土耳其服装贸易的报告。报告得出结论：通过回收工厂和纺织厂产生的棉花废料，土耳其服装业每年的支出可减少 18%。这份报告的一部分资金由土耳其政府提供。

土耳其服装业每年进口数千公吨棉花，但同时也会丢弃成堆的、缝制产品后剩下的棉花废料。目前，包括废弃纤维和剩余纱线在内的一部分废料被用作床垫填充物，但大部分则被当作垃圾焚烧。该合作组织的报告指出，回收更多边角料可以减少棉花进口，并节省大量资金。

土耳其服装制造商协会会长 Onur Arslan 表示：“行业领袖非常希望了解回收利用所产生的影响。”

Important information about time-tracking software
Hello, everyone,
Please note that we will soon be retiring the Kronos time-tracking software, as it has

data we collected from the survey you completed last week, we have decided to
continue using only the software the employees like better. Using only the Workmine

training, since they will not be able to access the Kronos program after April 25.

on creating reports and troubleshooting. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have
questions or concerns about this transition.
Sincerely,
Ben Nonaka
Director, Information Technology

questions.passage:
Hravn Announces Tour

LEEDS (17 May)—After a two-year break from touring, the Icelandic all-female band Hravn has announced an upcoming tour of the United Kingdom and Europe. — [1] —.

The band's Mystery Palace tour will begin in Leeds in the famed Victoria Garden before moving on to more than a dozen scheduled stops. The announcement was eagerly awaited by Hravn's many English fans, as the beloved rock band has recorded and released two new studio albums since it last went on tour. — [2] —.

The English rock band Wethersfield will be the opening act in the United Kingdom, but according to Dagur Arason, Hravn's tour manager, several other local rock music performers will open for the band at its European concerts. — [3] —.

Mr. Arason also confirmed that the band will soon be adding shows in North America. “I am negotiating with several venues in the United States and Canada right now,” he said.

“I'm excited to get back on the road and connect with our fans in person,” said lead guitarist Hallbera Lindarsdottir in a recent interview. “It will definitely be a show to remember!” — [4] —.

Tour dates are available on the band's Web site at www.hravn.is. Tickets can be purchased beginning on 22 June.

questions.content_translation:
Hravn 宣布巡演

利兹（5月17日）——在暂停巡演两年之后，冰岛全女子乐队 Hravn 宣布即将在英国和欧洲展开巡演。——[1]——

乐队的“神秘宫殿”巡演将从利兹著名的 Victoria Garden 开始，随后前往十多个已安排好的巡演站点。Hravn 众多英国歌迷一直热切期待这项公告，因为这支深受喜爱的摇滚乐队自上次巡演以来，已经录制并发行了两张新的录音室专辑。——[2]——

英国摇滚乐队 Wethersfield 将担任英国场次的暖场嘉宾；不过，据 Hravn 的巡演经理 Dagur Arason 表示，在欧洲各场演唱会上，还将有其他几位当地摇滚音乐表演者为该乐队暖场。——[3]——

Arason 先生还证实，乐队很快会增加北美场次。“我目前正在与美国和加拿大的几个演出场地洽谈，”他说。

“我很兴奋能再次踏上巡演之路，与歌迷面对面交流，”主音吉他手 Hallbera Lindarsdottir 最近接受采访时说，“这绝对会是一场令人难忘的演出！”——[4]——

巡演日期可在乐队网站 www.hravn.is 查询。门票将从 6 月 22 日起发售。

Marvin Gartner（上午7:31）
嗨，Simone、Julio。我正在为今天早上的早餐会议取餐。清单上的东西我都买到了，只有一些人特别要求的那种牛奶还没买。你们记得是哪一种吗？我本来应该把它记下来的。

Simone Bonny（上午7:33）
全脂牛奶和脱脂牛奶。每种一升应该就够了。

Marvin Gartner（上午7:34）
这两种我已经买了。但有些人喜欢不含乳糖的奶。是豆奶吗？燕麦奶吗？这里的种类太多了。

Julio Jimenez（上午7:40）
买杏仁奶。上周我调查团队成员的意见时，大家一致选择了这个。

Simone Bonny（上午7:41）
从没喝过。Marvin，那里有卖吗？

Julio Jimenez（上午7:42）
它很好喝，脂肪含量低，而且蛋白质含量高。

Marvin Gartner（上午7:45）
就在这儿。还需要别的吗？

Simone Bonny（上午7:46）
不用了。8:30 见！

questions.passage:
Copytrue Parts Service

If using classic older machinery in your manufacturing process is an integral part of your product's style and market identity, you know how frustrating it can be to try to find parts for equipment that has been in service for 50, 100, or 200 years or more. Don't let a broken part stop your production line and cut into your profits! Call Copytrue Parts Service. We are based in northern Massachusetts, with clients throughout Connecticut, New York, and Pennsylvania.

What we do
• We can use a broken part as a pattern and create a like-new intact replacement.
• Our machinists are avid experts in out-of-production and antique industrial equipment. They offer consulting services that will help you anticipate common breakages and get the parts you need before trouble starts.
• Our team can assess your company's maintenance routines and suggest improvements that will make old machinery last longer and function more efficiently.

We have worked on...
• metal presses and forges
• grain mills, waterwheels, and windmills
• industrial looms
• equipment made in England, Scotland, Ireland, France, Germany, Sweden, the United States, and other countries

Visit http://www.copytruepartsservice.com or call our main office at 978-555-0188 today!

Hinata Ishida <hishida91@lotuspond.net.jp>

Guardos Insurance <customersupport@guardosinsurance.com.au>

8 April
Subject:
How did we do?
Dear Ms. Ishida,
Guardos Insurance appreciates its many loyal customers and would like to thank you for
your trust in us. Since enrolling in our comprehensive motor vehicle insurance four years
ago, you have saved an average of $510 per year compared to the cost of policies from
leading competitors. Should you ever need insurance for your residence, for a commercial
property, or for travel, we have great insurance products for these too.
Last week you contacted us to raise the liability coverage of your comprehensive motor
vehicle insurance.
Because we value feedback from dedicated clients such as yourself, we would like to
know your impression regarding the quality of service provided by our customer service
agent Jillian Robins. Please take a minute to tell us how well Ms. Robins addressed your
needs by completing the form at https://www.guardosinsurance.com.au/feedback.
Sincerely,
Alec Clarkson, Manager
Customer Assistance Team
https://www.guardosinsurance.com.au/feedback

my liability coverage.
Ms. Robins answered my questions and explained everything clearly. She

choose the insurance coverage that is appropriate for my needs, and I was pleased
with her service.
-Ms. Hinata Ishida

发件人：Guardos Insurance <customersupport@guardosinsurance.com.au>
日期：4月8日
主题：我们的服务表现如何？

尊敬的 Ishida 女士：

Guardos Insurance 十分感谢众多忠实客户，并衷心感谢您对我们的信任。自四年前投保我们的综合机动车保险以来，与主要竞争对手的保单费用相比，您平均每年节省了 510 美元。如果您以后需要住宅保险、商业地产保险或旅行保险，我们也有针对这些需求的优质保险产品。

上周，您联系我们，要求提高综合机动车保险的责任险保额。

我们非常重视像您这样忠实客户的反馈，因此想了解您对客服专员 Jillian Robins 所提供服务质量的感受。请花一分钟时间填写 https://www.guardosinsurance.com.au/feedback 上的表格，告诉我们 Robins 女士在多大程度上满足了您的需求。

谨致问候！
Alec Clarkson，经理
客户协助团队

https://www.guardosinsurance.com.au/feedback

——Hinata Ishida 女士

CUSTOMS DECLARATION
From: Laura Persaud, Echelon International Hotel, 120 East Street, Queenstown, Georgetown, Guyana
Origin: Georgetown, GY
Shipping Date: 30 October
To: Giles Hawkins, 886 Main Street, Edmonton, Alberta T5M 3K3, Canada
Canada Customs: Cleared 2 November
Description of Contents: Excelsior Laptop Model RT3
Quantity: 1

Declaration of Exporter: I certify that the information on this form is correct and that the package does not contain dangerous or prohibited items.

To: Alya Naimi <alya.naimi@echeloninternationalhotel.com>
From: Giles Hawkins <ghawkins@drillritegeologicalservices.ca>
Date: 11 November
Subject: Recovered laptop

Dear Ms. Naimi,

I stayed at the Echelon International Hotel in Georgetown, Guyana, on 28 October while attending a conference. After I checked out the next day, I realized I had mistakenly left my laptop behind. Apparently, I left it on the seat of the desk chair. I was supposed to travel to the Northwest Territories to do some geological research shortly after my return to Canada, and I desperately needed my laptop because I rely heavily on its geological mapping program.

I called the hotel from the Georgetown Airport and explained the problem to the manager, who immediately jumped into action. She personally arranged to have the laptop shipped to my company's headquarters in Canada via expedited delivery. Thanks to her quick action, I received it the same day that it cleared customs, and the following day I departed for the Northwest Territories. This display of guest-focused service is indicative of the high standard I have come to expect from the entire Echelon International chain. It is why your hotels are my first choice when I travel in Central and South America.

Sincerely,
Giles Hawkins
Lead Geologist, Drillrite Geological Services

海关申报单
寄件人：Laura Persaud，Echelon International Hotel，120 East Street，Queenstown，Georgetown，Guyana
寄出地：Georgetown, GY
寄件日期：10月30日
收件人：Giles Hawkins，886 Main Street，Edmonton，Alberta T5M 3K3，Canada
加拿大海关：11月2日清关
内装物品说明：Excelsior RT3 型笔记本电脑
数量：1
重量：1.8 千克
目的地区域：第 2 区
邮费：7,500.00 美元
出口人声明：本人证明，本表格所填信息正确，且包裹中不含危险物品或违禁物品。
出口人签名：Laura Persaud

收件人：Alya Naimi <alya.naimi@echeloninternationalhotel.com>
发件人：Giles Hawkins <ghawkins@drillritegeologicalservices.ca>
日期：11月11日
主题：失而复得的笔记本电脑

尊敬的 Naimi 女士：

10 月 28 日，我在圭亚那乔治敦参加会议期间入住了 Echelon International Hotel。第二天退房后，我意识到自己不小心把笔记本电脑落在了酒店。显然，我把它遗留在书桌椅的座位上。我原计划回到加拿大后不久便前往西北地区开展地质研究，而我又十分依赖电脑中的地质绘图程序，因此迫切需要这台笔记本电脑。

我从乔治敦机场致电酒店，说明了问题，经理立即采取行动。她亲自安排通过加急配送，将笔记本电脑寄往我公司在加拿大的总部。多亏她迅速处理，我在电脑清关的当天就收到了它，并于次日前往西北地区。这种以住客为中心的服务，体现了我一直以来所期待的 Echelon International 连锁酒店整体的高品质标准。也正因如此，我在中美洲和南美洲旅行时总会首选贵酒店。

此致敬礼！
Giles Hawkins
Drillrite Geological Services 首席地质学家

questions.passage:
To: Janice Aria
From: Hector Cho
Date: Thursday, February 4
Subject: Anaheim conference
Attachment: April_9_information

Hi, Janice,

I'm happy to report that most of our staff will be attending the medical conference in Anaheim in April. We should coordinate our attendance as a group so that we can take advantage of the wide range of topics that will be covered.

I have attached a list of the presentations that will be given on the first day. I found them on the conference Web site. The lists for days two and three will be available next week. It sounds like these sessions will be useful for everyone on staff. We should arrange for at least one person to attend each presentation so we can share highlights with each other later.

I also wanted to let you know that I reserved a block of hotel rooms for us at a group rate. I haven't made transportation arrangements yet, but I'll keep you updated.

Best,
Hector

https://www.anaheimorthopedicsconference.org
Anaheim Orthopedics Conference Event Calendar, April 9
Welcome 8:00 A.M.–8:45 A.M. (Presidential Room): Introductions and overview
Session 1: The Shoulder 9:00 A.M.–10:30 A.M. (Room 201): Common injuries and exam techniques
Session 2: Splints and Casts 10:30 A.M.–12:00 noon (Room 202): New approaches to stabilizing injured joints
Session 3: The Knee 1:30 P.M.–3:00 P.M. (Room 201): Methods for identifying and treating ligament damage
Session 4: Exercises for Strength 3:00 P.M.–4:30 P.M. (Room 204): Recommendations for physical activities for children and adults

To: Hector Cho
From: Janice Aria
Date: Friday, February 5
Subject: RE: Anaheim conference

Hector,

I like your suggestion of coordinating our conference attendance. I can create an informal sign-up document so that everyone can get an idea of what sessions are available and we can make sure we cover all of them.

I appreciate the information from the Web site. I didn't know it was already available. I definitely want to attend the session on dealing with ligament injuries. Once we get the schedule for the additional conference sessions, I'll send it out to the team, together with the attendance sign-up sheet.

It's great that you were able to get that group discount. Conferences like this are a big expense, but your efforts will certainly save us money.

Thanks,
Janice

questions.content_translation:
收件人：Janice Aria
发件人：Hector Cho
日期：2月4日，星期四
主题：阿纳海姆会议
附件：April_9_information

嗨，Janice：

很高兴地告诉你，我们大多数员工都将参加四月份在阿纳海姆举行的医学会议。我们应该协调好团队成员的参会安排，以便充分利用会议将涵盖的众多主题。

我附上了会议第一天的报告清单。这些信息是我从会议网站上找到的。第二天和第三天的清单将于下周公布。这些分会听起来对每位员工都会有帮助。我们应该安排每场报告至少有一人参加，这样之后就能互相分享重点内容。

另外，我还想告诉你，我以团体价为大家预订了一批酒店客房。我尚未安排交通，不过会随时向你通报进展。

祝好！
Hector

https://www.anaheimorthopedicsconference.org
阿纳海姆骨科会议活动日程，4月9日
欢迎环节 上午8:00–8:45（Presidential Room）：介绍和概览
分会 1：肩部 上午9:00–10:30（201室）：常见损伤及检查方法
分会 2：夹板与石膏 上午10:30–中午12:00（202室）：固定受伤关节的新方法
分会 3：膝部 下午1:30–3:00（201室）：识别和治疗韧带损伤的方法
分会 4：增强力量的锻炼 下午3:00–4:30（204室）：适合儿童和成人的身体活动建议

收件人：Hector Cho
发件人：Janice Aria
日期：2月5日，星期五
主题：回复：阿纳海姆会议

Hector：

我赞成你提出的协调参会安排的建议。我可以创建一份非正式的报名文件，让大家了解有哪些分会可选，并确保我们每一场都有人参加。

谢谢你提供网站上的信息。我之前不知道日程已经发布了。我肯定想参加关于处理韧带损伤的那场分会。等我们拿到其他会议分会的日程后，我会将它和参会报名表一起发给团队。

你能争取到团体折扣真是太好了。参加这类会议是一笔很大的开支，但你的努力肯定能帮我们省钱。

谢谢！
Janice

questions.passage:
An Unexpected Plot Twist for a Seasoned Mystery Novelist

Fans of Delia Ramiro's mystery novels may be surprised when opening her new book. While Ms. Ramiro's novels usually feature crafty detectives and suspenseful plots interwoven with lengthy descriptions of mouthwatering meals, The Vanishing Plate is all about the recipes.

This attractive cookbook gives detailed instructions for making the many dishes featured in Ms. Ramiro's fiction, such as the lentil soup served by Derek Donne at the end of The Alpine Enigma, the debut novel that was published while Ms. Ramiro was still a university student.

“My literary agent, Bernice Holm, wanted me to write another international thriller,” Ms. Ramiro said recently in an interview. “But readers kept asking me about the cuisine in my novels. They wanted to know how they could make it themselves!”

For Ms. Ramiro, the new book is not as big a departure as it may seem. “As a child, I read cookbooks like they were novels,” she said. “For me back then, The Saffron Table was as exciting as any adventure story.”

When asked whether she expects the new book to be as successful as her previous one, The Garnet Butterfly, Ms. Ramiro had a quick answer. “It may not sell as many copies, but people will want to keep it for years,” she said. “The images in the book are works of art all on their own. Even if you don't make my version of chocolate soufflé, you'll be enchanted by the photograph of it.”

The Vanishing Plate by Delia Ramiro. 300 pages. Sand Street Publishing. $50.

https://www.thebooknews.com/reviews/20sept/vanishing_plate
Hudson Keita Reviews The Vanishing Plate

It would seem that everyone is a chef these days. So far this year no fewer than 20 cookbooks by celebrities—actors, writers, and athletes—have hit bookstore shelves. Fortunately, Delia Ramiro's The Vanishing Plate is one of those rare celebrity cookbooks that can hold its own alongside those by professional chefs. This handsomely produced volume, featuring photographs by Selda Solberg and a foreword by award-winning chef Lukas Fogt, features over 100 creative and tantalizing recipes. Despite the puzzling title, the recipes themselves are clearly written and generously detailed. If only the book were not priced so exorbitantly ($50 for a cookbook?), I would say that it should become a staple in the kitchen of every home cook.

THE SOUTHWESTERNER MONTHLY
Book Review: Delia Ramiro's The Vanishing Plate

Delia Ramiro's The Vanishing Plate is not for the faint of heart. Inspired by scenes in the novelist's acclaimed mysteries and thrillers, the recipes are significantly more complicated than those in your typical gourmet cookbook. Most of Ramiro's recipes assume the reader is proficient in mid-level cooking techniques, and a few recipes would likely be attempted only by cooks with professional experience. If you are the ideal reader who is up to the challenge, however, the book will not disappoint you. All the recipes are innovative—not one failed to surprise me in one way or another—and they produce dishes that I believe would impress even the most discriminating diner. That said, the book is not without its faults. In addition to a hefty price tag, it devotes too much space to the history of the ingredients. While such information can be interesting, I would have preferred a trimmer, more concise book that showcases the recipes themselves and is easier to handle in the kitchen.

—Paulina Yu

questions.content_translation:
资深推理小说家带来的意外情节转折

Delia Ramiro 推理小说的读者翻开她的新书时可能会大吃一惊。Ramiro 女士的小说通常以机智的侦探和扣人心弦的情节为特色，故事中还穿插着对令人垂涎佳肴的大段描写；然而，《The Vanishing Plate》完全是一本关于食谱的书。

这本精美的烹饪书详细介绍了 Ramiro 女士小说中许多菜肴的制作方法，例如在《The Alpine Enigma》结尾由 Derek Donne 端上的扁豆汤。《The Alpine Enigma》是她的处女作，出版时 Ramiro 女士还是一名大学生。

“我的文学经纪人 Bernice Holm 希望我再写一部国际惊悚小说，”Ramiro 女士最近接受采访时说，“但是，读者一直在询问我小说中的美食。他们想知道自己怎样才能做出这些菜！”

对 Ramiro 女士来说，这本新书并不像表面看起来那样偏离她过去的创作。“小时候，我读烹饪书就像读小说一样，”她说，“对当时的我而言，《The Saffron Table》和任何冒险故事一样精彩。”

当被问及她是否预计新书能像上一部作品《The Garnet Butterfly》一样成功时，Ramiro 女士很快给出了回答。“它的销量可能不会那么高，但人们会愿意把它珍藏多年，”她说，“书中的图片本身就是艺术品。即使你不打算照我的方法制作巧克力舒芙蕾，也会被它的照片迷住。”

《The Vanishing Plate》，作者 Delia Ramiro。300 页。Sand Street Publishing 出版。售价 50 美元。

https://www.thebooknews.com/reviews/20sept/vanishing_plate
Hudson Keita 书评：《The Vanishing Plate》

如今似乎人人都是厨师。仅在今年，到目前为止就已有不少于 20 本由演员、作家和运动员等名人撰写的烹饪书登上书店货架。幸运的是，Delia Ramiro 的《The Vanishing Plate》是少数能与专业厨师作品相媲美的名人烹饪书之一。这本制作精美的书收录了 100 多道富有创意、令人垂涎的食谱，照片由 Selda Solberg 拍摄，前言则由获奖厨师 Lukas Fogt 撰写。尽管书名令人费解，但食谱本身写得清楚明白，细节也十分充分。要不是这本书定价贵得离谱（一本烹饪书竟要 50 美元？），我会说它应当成为每位家庭厨师厨房中的必备书。

《THE SOUTHWESTERNER MONTHLY》
书评：Delia Ramiro 的《The Vanishing Plate》

Delia Ramiro 的《The Vanishing Plate》不适合缺乏勇气的人。这些食谱的灵感来自这位小说家广受好评的推理及惊悚小说中的场景，其复杂程度远超一般的美食烹饪书。Ramiro 的大多数食谱都假定读者熟练掌握中级烹饪技巧，其中少数食谱可能只有具备专业经验的厨师才会尝试。不过，如果你是勇于迎接挑战的理想读者，这本书不会令你失望。所有食谱都很有创意——每一道都以某种方式给我带来惊喜——做出的菜肴甚至会令最挑剔的食客赞叹不已。话虽如此，这本书并非没有缺点。除了价格不菲，它还用了太多篇幅介绍食材的历史。尽管这些信息可能颇有趣味，但我更希望这本书精简一些、更简洁一些，把重点放在食谱本身，也更方便在厨房中拿取使用。

——Paulina Yu
